clues: This town is the chief town of its county, and the fourth town of its land by size. It lies a short way north of the land's great chief town.
At the year's high point this town sees more than eight-teen hours of sun in a day. At its low point, less than six.
This town's school of high learning was set up in 1477. It is the most old such house in all the north lands.
Two world-famed minds did their work in this town. One made the heat scale men use now; one named all life in ranks.
The most big church of all the north lands stands in this town. It was the crown seat of kings for age on age.
